title: TENET: Time-point Encoding Network for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.32337v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In unsupervised multivariate time series anomaly detection (MTSAD), local variation can inflate reconstruction and forecasting errors, making observation-space discrepancy an unreliable indicator of abnormal system behavior. Since latent-space scoring can mitigate this limitation, we reframe one-class MTSAD as current-point system-state compatibility estimation and propose TENET, the Time-point Encoding Network for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection. We define the current-point system state as a latent representation of the target time point, constructed from variable-level temporal context in the input window. translated_title: TENET：用于多元时间序列异常检测的时间点编码网络
translated_abstract: 在无监督多元时间序列异常检测（MTSAD）中，局部变化会放大重构和预测误差，使得观测空间差异成为判断系统异常行为的不可靠指标。由于潜在空间评分可以缓解这一局限，我们将单类多元时间序列异常检测重新表述为当前点系统状态兼容性估计问题，并提出TENET——用于多元时间序列异常检测的时间点编码网络。我们将当前点系统状态定义为目标时间点的潜在表示，该表示由输入窗口中的变量级时间上下文构建。TENET通过一个时间层来构建该状态：该层检索相对于当前点的窗口上下文，使用以当前点为中心的嵌入对时间进行编码，并将检索到的上下文与当前表示进行自适应混合。借助这一设计，TENET不再将输入窗口视为需要重构的对象（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: TENET将无监督多元时间序列异常检测重新表述为当前点系统状态兼容性估计，通过以当前点为中心的时间编码和上下文自适应混合构建潜在状态表示，从而克服了观测空间差异作为异常指标不可靠的问题。
en_tdlr: TENET reframes unsupervised multivariate time series anomaly detection as current-point system-state compatibility estimation, constructing latent state representations via current-point-centered temporal encoding and adaptive context mixing to overcome the unreliability of observation-space discrepancy as an anomaly indicator.
